about: Reviewer decisions for claims produced by real extraction runs (origin: extracted). Claim IDs come from `pnpm review:report`; they change only when a new extraction run replaces the old one. Actions: approve, reject (note required), correct (note and `set` required). These decisions for the extract-prompt-v2 runs of 2026-10-18 (issue #22) were drafted by Claude Code, judged only against each claim's quoted evidence and the source documents; owner to confirm.
